Mapping and localization ignore points closer than this to the LiDAR, so the person carrying it does not end up in the map. Reduce it in tight spaces. (Default %1$.1f m; does not affect the live view.)
Intensity: weakly reflecting surfaces are blue, strong ones red.\nHeight: points are coloured by height.\nPCD files without intensity are coloured by height.
View or change the Mid-360\'s IP address and where it sends its data (this %1$s\'s IP).

Try live view, mapping, PCD saving and localization without a Mid-360, using simulated data of someone walking through a room. While this is on, it mixes with data from a real sensor, so turn it off when using real hardware.
Demo mode is on. To change the settings of a real sensor, turn the demo off in Settings.
The Mid-360\'s current IP. Filled in automatically when the sensor is detected. The %1$s\'s IP must be on the same subnet as this address to change settings.
The destination IP is not on the same subnet as the Mid-360\'s IP.
The Mid-360 and the destination cannot use the same IP.
Changing the Mid-360\'s IP restarts the Mid-360 after writing (takes 10–20 seconds).
Changing only the destination takes effect immediately, without a restart.

Settings are stored in the Mid-360 and kept when it is powered off. If you lose track of them, you can restore the factory settings (Mid-360: 192.168.1.1XX, destination: 192.168.1.50) with Livox Viewer 2 or similar tools.
Settings written. The Mid-360 is restarting.
In the %1$s\'s settings (on Galaxy: Connections → More connection settings → Ethernet), set the wired LAN IP address to %2$s and the subnet mask to %3$s.
No response from the Mid-360. Check that its IP address is correct and that the %1$s\'s IP is on the same subnet as the Mid-360.
The Mid-360 rejected the settings (ret_code 0x%1$02X, key 0x%2$04X)
Could not understand the response from the Mid-360.
Connect a Livox Mid-360 over wired Ethernet to build 3D maps and localize on the spot.

This app does not collect any personal information or usage data. The network is used only to talk to a LiDAR connected over wired Ethernet and to send files over SFTP to servers you specify. Maps are stored on this %1$s in Download/MobileNDT, and recordings in the app\'s own folder; they are sent only to the destination you choose when you send them via SFTP or share them.

The LiDAR-inertial odometry is an independent implementation following the FAST-LIO formulation (W. Xu, F. Zhang, RA-L 2021). Communication with the Mid-360 is an independent implementation of its published protocol and does not use the Livox SDK.
"Download/MobileNDT tap to view · long-press to share or delete"
No saved maps yet.\nAfter mapping, tap “Save PCD”.\nTo use a PCD from a computer or elsewhere, use “Open File”.
Stop first, then choose a rosbag
No rosbags yet.\nRecord one with “● Record”, or import an MCAP file made with ros2 bag record via “Open File”.

Tap to choose · long-press to share, send via SFTP or delete.\nSupported: ROS 2 MCAP (uncompressed, zstd, lz4) with a PointCloud2 or Livox CustomMsg topic and an Imu topic. Recordings are in Android/data/%1$s/files.

ROS 2 (MCAP): records /livox/imu (sensor_msgs/Imu) and /livox/lidar (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 with per-point timestamps). Opens directly in ros2 bag play and Foxglove.\nRaw packets: saves the Mid-360\'s UDP packets as they are.
Playback speed when running SLAM from a rosbag. When faster, processing may fall behind and drop scans.
Changes apply when you return to the main screen (resolutions from the next start). If unsure, keep the defaults.
Position of the LiDAR origin seen from the IMU. Keep the defaults for the Mid-360\'s built-in IMU.
Points farther than this are not used.
Voxel size for thinning the points used for registration. Larger is faster; smaller aligns more finely.
Point spacing of the saved PCD. Smaller is finer and makes larger files. Applies from the next start.
Maximum Kalman filter update iterations per scan.
Tolerance when fitting a plane to nearby points.
Upper limit of the squared distance to the 5th point of a plane.
Smaller trusts the LiDAR more; larger trusts the IMU more.
Size of the voxels representing the map for localization.
While tracking, results with a lower match ratio are not used.
Range searched around the given initial pose.
Send PCDs and rosbags to a PC or server over SFTP, from the PCD viewer and rosbag lists (long-press a file).
The current key will stop working. Register the new public key on each server again.
The private key is stored only on this device, encrypted with a key in the Android Keystore, and never leaves it. Copy the public key and add it as one line to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the server.
Tap to edit · long-press to delete.
No destinations. Add one. Create the key pair and copy the public key in Settings › SFTP.
A path starting with / is absolute; otherwise it is relative to the login directory. Missing folders are created. Leave empty to send to the login directory.
The password is stored on this device, encrypted with a key in the Android Keystore.
Register the public key copied in the SFTP settings on the server.
Create a key pair in the SFTP settings and register the public key on the server.
The server\'s key from the first connection. Files are not sent to a server with a different key. Reset it if the server was replaced.
No key pair. Create one in the SFTP settings.
The server\'s host key differs from last time. Check that this is the right server, and if so, reset the host key in the destination settings.
Authentication failed (check the registered public key, user name and password)
